title: Effect of a Calcium Silicate-Specific Solvent on Filling Material Removal during Retreatment and Subsequent Multisonic Irrigation: A Micro-CT Study
html: Complete removal of calcium silicate-based sealers (CSS) during retreatment remains challenging. This study evaluated the effect of a calcium silicate-specific solvent on filling-material removal during retreatment and during subsequent multisonic irrigation.
